findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evaluation_basic, analyze_participation, awarded_prices, tenders_outside_pncp, remove_saved, who_supplies, open_tenders_in_field, create_owner, get_owner, create_alert · Private data: evaluation_quota, evaluation_premium, evaluation_basic, evaluation_basic_result, company_documents, attach_company_document, remove_company_document, analyze_participation, get_participation, add_company, framework_agreements, my_account, my_documents, my_procurements, claim_guest_tracking, original_status, request_original, list_examples, get_document, get_document_dossier, list_document_files, health, get_deadlines, get_procurement, get_tender_markdown, get_reading_manifest, create_owner, get_owner, rotate_webhook_secret, create_alert, create_alerts_by_cnpj, list_alert_matches, watch_procurement, list_watch_events, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj · Public sink: analyze_participation, awarded_prices, tenders_outside_pncp, account_tracking, who_supplies, open_tenders_in_field, get_reading_manifest, create_owner, get_owner, rotate_webhook_secret, create_alert, create_alerts_by_cnpj · Destructive: remove_company_document, get_participation, select_company, remove_company, remove_saved.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evaluation_basic, analyze_participation, awarded_prices, tenders_outside_pncp, remove_saved, who_supplies, open_tenders_in_field, create_owner, get_owner, create_alert · Private data: evaluation_quota, evaluation_premium, evaluation_basic, evaluation_basic_result, company_documents, attach_company_document, remove_company_document, analyze_participation, get_participation, add_company, framework_agreements, my_account, my_documents, my_procurements, claim_guest_tracking, original_status, request_original, list_examples, get_document, get_document_dossier, list_document_files, health, get_deadlines, get_procurement, get_tender_markdown, get_reading_manifest, create_owner, get_owner, rotate_webhook_secret, create_alert, create_alerts_by_cnpj, list_alert_matches, watch_procurement, list_watch_events, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj · Public sink: analyze_participation, awarded_prices, tenders_outside_pncp, account_tracking, who_supplies, open_tenders_in_field, get_reading_manifest, create_owner, get_owner, rotate_webhook_secret, create_alert, create_alerts_by_cnpj · Destructive: remove_company_document, get_participation, select_company, remove_company, remove_saved

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
